summary: Create an AAP instance from the Ansible Automation Platform tile (Details tab) with a spec setting database requests, controller, eda and hub (file storage on a RWX storage class), then check All instances and that pods are Running or Completed.
questions: How do I create an Ansible Automation Platform instance in the OpenShift console?
Example spec for AAP with controller, EDA and hub
How do I link components to the platform gateway?

answer_card.title: Create the AAP instance
answer_card.answer_md:
Operators > Installed Operators > AAP > Details > *Ansible Automation Platform* > Create instance > YAML view:
```yaml
spec:
  database:
    resource_requirements:
      requests: {cpu: 200m, memory: 512Mi}
    storage_requirements:
      requests: {storage: 100Gi}
  controller:
    disabled: false
  eda:
    disabled: false
  hub:
    disabled: false
    storage_type: file
    file_storage_storage_class: <read-write-many-storage-class>
    file_storage_size: 10Gi
```
Verify instances in *All instances* and pods *Running*/*Completed*.
